full_judgment:
This is a jail appeal preferred by Abdul Khalcquc and Barek against the judgment and order passed on 16.1.84 by Mr. A.T.M. Fazle Kabir, Assistant Sessions Judge and Special Tribunal No. V Khulna in Special Tribunal Case No. 143 of 1982 convicting both of them on a charge under section 19(f) of the Arms Act and sentencing each of them there under to suffer rigorous imprisonment for a term of 3 years. 

 12. In the result the appeal is allowed. The impugned order passed on 16.1.84 by the Assistant Sessions Judge and Special Tribunal No. V Khulna in Special Tribunal case No. 143 of 1982 convicting the appellants Abdul Khaleque and Abdul Barek under section 19(1) of Arms Act and sentencing them there under to suffer R.I. for 3 years is set aside. It is directed that they be set at liberty at once if not wanted in connection with any other case.
